fact_sheet.fact: On November 15, 2023, Alex Chen's LDL Cholesterol (LDL-C) was 145 mg/dL.
On February 20, 2024, Alex Chen's LDL Cholesterol (LDL-C) was 115 mg/dL.
On May 25, 2024, Alex Chen's LDL Cholesterol (LDL-C) was 98 mg/dL.
On November 15, 2023, Alex Chen's Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) was 5.9%.
On February 20, 2024, Alex Chen's Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) was 5.8%.
On May 25, 2024, Alex Chen's Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) was 5.7%.
On November 15, 2023, Alex Chen's Triglycerides were 180 mg/dL.
On February 20, 2024, Alex Chen's Triglycerides were 160 mg/dL.
On May 25, 2024, Alex Chen's Triglycerides were 145 mg/dL.
On November 15, 2023, Alex Chen's Serum Creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL.
On February 20, 2024, Alex Chen's Serum Creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL.
On May 25, 2024, Alex Chen's Serum Creatinine was 1.0 mg/dL.
Following the November 15, 2023 lab results, Dr. Evelyn Reed diagnosed Alex Chen with Hyperlipidemia.
Based on the consistent HbA1c results, Alex Chen has a standing diagnosis of Prediabetes.
On November 17, 2023, Dr. Reed prescribed Rosuvastatin 10 mg to be taken once daily in the evening.
The prescription for Rosuvastatin 10 mg (ID# RX789012) was filled at Sterling Pharmacy with 2 refills remaining as of May 28, 2024.
Alex Chen has reported no side effects, such as muscle pain or weakness, from taking Rosuvastatin.
Dr. Reed recommended a dietary goal of consuming at least 30 grams of fiber per day.
A key dietary recommendation for Alex Chen is to limit saturated fat intake to less than 15 grams per day.
The recommended exercise regimen is a minimum of 150 minutes of moderate-intensity cardiovascular activity per week, such as brisk walking or cycling.
Dr. Reed advised Alex Chen to limit alcohol consumption to a maximum of two standard drinks per day.
Alex Chen's next follow-up appointment with Dr. Evelyn Reed at Northwood Medical Group is scheduled for November 28, 2024, at 10:30 AM.
A lab order for a new lipid panel and HbA1c test has been placed with QuestPath Diagnostics for the week before the November 28, 2024 appointment.
A referral was made on November 17, 2023, for Alex Chen to consult with registered dietitian Maria Flores for personalized meal planning.
Non-urgent questions for Dr. Reed can be sent via the 'MyHealthLink' patient portal at https://myhealthlink.northwood.fictional.

Alex Chen should immediately report any unexplained severe muscle pain or dark-colored urine to Northwood Medical Group's on-call nurse at 555-0123, as it could be a rare side effect of his medication.
Symptoms of excessive thirst, frequent urination, or blurred vision should be reported promptly, as they may indicate a progression of prediabetes.
If Alex Chen develops excessive thirst, frequent urination, or blurred vision, he should report those symptoms promptly to Dr. Reed's office rather than waiting for the next follow-up appointment.
